notes.title: 1.4.2.7 Version Update ( Hotspot Is Live Now !)
notes.notes:
This Update Includes :
[list]
[*] New Icons.
[*] Improved performance (Less memory usage)
[*] And a network program must have Hotspot feature. And here it is 1.4.2.7 update also includes Hotspot.
[/list]

A note about it :
Hotspot button will be disabled if network card doesn't support this feature.

notes.title: Latest Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone.
Today i added a new section named "Records".
Basicly it shows you your last DNS records even incognito modes for browsers too. You can see, export and delete this records.

You can use this section for parental control or personal privacy. You can duplicate samples it is up to you.

Have a nice day.
